college_identity.verified_name: National Institute of Technology Karnataka (NITK), Surathkal
college_identity.identity_notes: Formerly Karnataka Regional Engineering College (KREC), established 1960; upgraded to NITK in 2002; Institute of National Importance under NIT Act 2007. Campus named Srinivasnagar after founder U. Srinivasa Mallya. Single main campus (~295-300 acres, described in some sources as split into western/eastern sections by a road) adjacent to the Arabian Sea, with a private beach frequently cited across reviews. Verified distinct from unrelated institutions such as 'Navodaya Institute of Technology' (a separate private college in Raichur, Karnataka) that could be confused due to shared 'NIT' abbreviation usage in casual speech.

review_items.review_title: Pros and cons of NIT-K, Surathkal

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'If you are expecting an average package of 30 lakhs in civil, then you will definitely be disappointed, but the placements are surely satisfying here. This year placement was 67%, but many people go for further studies and hence don't take campus placements... Average package in civil was around Rs. 6 lakhs per annum this year and the highest was around Rs. 13 lakhs per annum... L&T was the major recruiter in general. More than 30 students grabbed top internships in the third year, and nearly 60% students got a direct internship.'

'When we consider master degree courses like M.Tech, MBA and M.Sc, the above-said percentage is below 50 percent, still NITK possesses high placements as compared to other [colleges].' Framed as a comparative negative for PG placement rates specifically.

'NITK is famous for its infrastructure. It consists of two campuses, western and eastern on both sides of the road... good facility departments, swimming pools, playgrounds, banks, schools etc. The main attraction of NITK was its private beach.'

'NITK is an autonomous college. It decides its own courses, curriculum, and faculty members... has a very efficient board which repeatedly reviews and changes its curriculum so that students are exposed to the new industrial atmosphere.'

review_items.review_title: My review of Mining Engineering at NITK, Surathkal

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'On-campus internships are negligible, though a few students secure off-campus internships.'

'Vedanta & JSW are the major recruiters for Mining. Vedanta gives good packages than any other core company... CTC is 16 LPA (2025) for mining engineers, and other core branch has around 14 LPA (2025).' Notes eligibility constraint: Vedanta 'requires a maximum gap of 1 year' between 12th/PUC and engineering.

'Hostels are good. In the first year of B.Tech, 3 students need to stay in a shared room. In the second year, 2 students. In the 3rd & 4th year, students are allotted a single sharing room in mega tower hostels. Now all rooms have LAN facilities, but it fluctuates.'
'The college has good connectivity and can get a scholarship through SSP and NSP portals.'

'In the mechanical engineering branch, the placement percentage is okay and it is 85%. The highest package is 36 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 12 LPA, which is decent. Top recruiting companies for our course are Ola, Uber, Flipkart, Amazon, etc. 70% of students get internships if they do well. Many students go into the software field rather than the core field.'
'The infrastructure is good.'

review_items.review_title: How is hostel life at NIT Surathkal?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Hostel life in NITK is going to teach you much more about yourself than anything else in college. You learn to adapt to any situation, you learn to manage cash flawlessly, and after 4 years here you'll be filled with a sense of confidence.'

review_items.review_title: How is your hostel room in NIT Surathkal?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Water, power and internet are all there about 70% of the time I guess. Power and water become a little short in the summer months but it's generally manageable. Internet is fickle from time to time with regards to speed and blocking of sites.'

'The sports complex is right in the middle of the campus and the ground is filled with a number of games occurring simultaneously... Weekends are split between exploring Mangalore, making plans to go on trips, going on trips.' Also notes 'Boys generally don't have a curfew as such.'

review_items.review_title: Is there any serious ragging in NITK Surathkal?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Ragging at NITK is not at all a serious issue, thanks to several regulations in place. Apart from casual introduction sessions and senior-junior interaction, which can be described as a very well organized phenomenon, seniors are friendly if you maintain a decent, respectful relationship with them.'
